You will develop in-depth knowledge of our products and use your technical experience and enthusiasm to resolve issues, support customers and share knowledge with other members of the team. About Maverick Diagnostics: Based in Wrexham, Wales, Maverick Diagnostics is a trailblazer in the automotive aftermarket industry, specialising in dealer tools, technical support, training and vehicle technical services. Our team provides remote support to ensure that our customers’ hardware and software continue to operate at peak efficiency. At Maverick Diagnostics, our values are more than just words; they are guiding principles that shape our culture, decisions and interactions. We believe that by embodying these values, we not only define who we are as a company but also set the foundation for our success and growth. You will be a great fit at Maverick Diagnostics if you value Respect, Positivity, Results, Teamwork, Excellence in Customer Relations, Continuous Learning and Innovation. Key Accountabilities Include: Provide high-quality remote technical support, diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues efficiently. Manage customer enquiries through telephone, email, remote-access software and our support ticketing system. Install, configure, monitor and update diagnostic tools and software to minimise customer downtime. Take ownership of support cases through to resolution, keeping customers informed and escalating complex issues when required. Maintain accurate records and identify recurring issues or opportunities to improve our service. Work closely with colleagues across the business, sharing technical knowledge and contributing ideas to improve systems and processes. What We’re Looking For: At least three years’ experience in technical support, IT support or a similar customer-facing technical role. Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues methodically. Experience supporting hardware, software and Windows-based systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. An active listener with an empathetic and patient approach. A strong commitment to delivering outstanding customer service and taking ownership of problems. The ability to explain technical information clearly to customers with different levels of knowledge. The confidence to manage complex cases and work independently when required. A collaborative approach and willingness to share knowledge with colleagues. Support achievement of the company’s orders targets year on year Be familiar with all ITT Goulds Pumps products and services Be familiar with company organization structure, chain of command, policies and procedures. review_candidates.title: Principal AI Technical Product Manager - Synopsys ICV
review_candidates.description: We Are: At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. You Are: The ideal candidate will have expertise in AI and Large Learning Models (LLM) used in the semiconductor verification market to help develop and drive Synopsys ICV AI use models for established process nodes to support advanced market needs. In this role you will be able to envision and prototype AI concepts that could accelerate semiconductor verification solutions and validate them in actual market use models. This is especially critical as the market is moving into the rapidly evolving combination of established process node, and advanced process nodes due to the rapidly expanding 3D and Chiplet market. You are interacting with the rest of Product Management, Technical Sales, and customers to have a complete understanding as to what specific AI use models need to be incorporated into product roadmaps to support the multiple markets that Synopsys interacts with. You are highly motivated, with a passion for innovation and the ability to work collaboratively across engineering, product management and sales teams to ensure alignment to initiatives. You are comfortable working as an individual contributor on multiple special projects while at the same time influence managing Technical Sales, R&D, and Product Management. What You’ll Be Doing: You will work with the Executive Director of Synopsys ICV for Established Nodes to conceptualize, prototype, and validate AI use models across the Synopsys ICV offering. These use models will be applicable for development and QA of core Synopsys ICV products and for customer applications throughout the Synopsys ICV product line. Special focus will be on the application of AI within strategies for Synopsys ICV established process node designs that align with advanced process nodes on the same 3D system and with overall Synopsys ICV broader business objectives. You will work with the rest of the 3D established node product managers to train and educate Synopsys Technical sales. Also work with Technical Sales to explain how to address customer unique requirements that calls for funded customization and support. You will work closely with the rest of Synopsys ICV product management, R&D and sales teams to align ICV AI based needs with Synopsys product development and go-to-market strategies. The Impact You Will Have: Accelerate Synopsys’ ICV strategic positioning in the 3D and Chiplet established node market via identification and development of competitive differentiation using AI based techniques. Strengthen Synopsys’ influence and thought leadership within the semiconductor ecosystem and customer base through compelling presentations and engagement via AI driven use models as how Synopsys ICV is the solutions for the new 3D/Chiplet market. What You’ll Need: 10+ years of relevant EDA/semiconductor product management experience. 5+ years of experience in development of solutions that include AI and LLM techniques BS/MS, in Electrical Engineering and or Device Physics required. PhD or MBA in your field desired. Understanding of Semiconductor ecosystem, and expertise with Foundry, EDA PDK development and associated relationships for DRC functions and Rules. Proven ability to work with Product Management senior managers to help define what is a customer specific need vs a general market requirement where they could be an industry leading teacher-customer. Exceptional ability to drive and achieve results by yourself and others under time pressure. Excellent presentation, communications, and interpersonal skills. Ability to travel at least 20% of the time. The Team You’ll Be A Part Of: You will be working with senior management to create a dynamic team focused on greatly expanding Synopsys’ ICV product offerings and market positioning in the established node/3D design environment. This team will work closely with Line of Business (LoB) product management, sales, and R&D to align ecosystem offerings with Synopsys’ ICV overall strategic goals. As a key component of the overall Synopsys EDA Product Management Group, this team will identify and cultivate new opportunities, drive collaborative initiatives, and promote joint marketing programs to deliver solutions to the semiconductor market that mutual established node customers need as the world moves into multiple ways to design their offerings. It is no longer just “let’s go to the next process node” but a “how do we best design this” world. Rewards and Benefits: We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request.

review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), London (UK), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.
